location: Wyoming State Capitol W110 200 West 24th Street
title: The purpose of this meeting is to receive testimony from agencies with supplemental budget requests for the 2027-2028 biennium and take final consideration of draft legislation not acted on in the 2026 interim. The meeting will be held in person in Cheyenne with a live video stream available on the Legislature's Website (www.wyoleg.gov). A limited number of participants can sign up to provide public comment virtually. Public comment will be taken on any legislation discussed at the time of consideration.
